en.s: The Battle of Uhud (Arabic: غزوة أحد‎‎ Ġazwat ‘Uḥud) was fought on Saturday, March 23, 625 (7 Shawwal 3 AH in the Islamic calendar) at the valley located in front of Mount Uhud, in what is now northwestern Arabia. It occurred between a force from the Muslim community of Medina led by the Islamic prophet Muhammad, and a force led by Abu Sufyan ibn Harb from Mecca, the town from which many of the Muslims had previously emigrated. The Battle of Uhud was the second military encounter between the Meccans and the Muslims, preceded by the Battle of Badr in 624, where a small Muslim army had defeated a larger Meccan army.

zh.s: 伍侯德战役于625年3月23日星期六（伊斯兰历3年闪瓦鲁月7日），在今阿拉伯半岛西北部伍侯德山前的山谷发生。伊斯兰先知穆罕默德率麦地那穆斯林社群的军队，对阵阿布·苏富扬·伊本·哈卜率领的麦加军队，许多穆斯林此前正是从麦加迁出的。这是麦加人与穆斯林之间的第二次军事交锋。此前在624年白德尔战役中，人数较少的穆斯林军队曾击败更大规模的麦加军队。

en.s: The Battle of Cesar, in Portuguese: Batalha de Cesar, was a battle that took place on 23 March 1035, between the armies of Bermudo III, King of León, and the Moorish armies of Abu'l-Qasim, the emir of the Taifa of Seville, near the village of Cesar, Aveiro.

en.s: Henry VIII (28 June 1491 – 28 January 1547) was King of England and Ireland from 22 April 1509 until his death in 1547. en.s: In 1757 war broke out between France and Great Britain, and Colonel Robert Clive of the British East India Company and Admiral Charles Watson of the Royal Navy bombarded and captured Chandannagar on 23 March 1757. The town's fortifications and many houses were demolished thereafter, and Chandannagar's importance as a commercial centre was eclipsed by that of Calcutta just downriver. Chandannagar was restored to the French in 1763, but retaken by the British in 1794 in the Napoleonic Wars. The city was returned to France in 1816, along with a 3 sq mi (7.8 km2) enclave of surrounding territory.

zh.s: 1757年，法国与英国爆发战争。3月23日，英国东印度公司的罗伯特·克莱武上校，与皇家海军查尔斯·沃森海军上将炮击并攻占钱德纳戈尔。此后，该城防御工事和许多房屋被拆毁，商业中心的重要性被下游不远的加尔各答超过。钱德纳戈尔于1763年归还法国，但在拿破仑战争期间，于1794年再次被英国夺取。1816年，该城及周边3平方英里（7.8平方公里）的飞地又归还法国。

en.s: Vaudreuil's raid, also known as the Battle of Fort William Henry, in March 1757 was a significant winter military operation during the French and Indian War, part of the broader conflict between Britain and France for control of North America. Under the command of Governor François-Pierre Rigaud de Vaudreuil, a French force of approximately 1,600 regulars, Canadian militia, and Native American allies marched across frozen terrain to strike at the British fort located at the southern end of Lake George, in the Province of New York.

zh.s: 1757年3月的沃德勒伊突袭是法国与印第安人战争期间冬季的一次重要军事行动，该战争是英法争夺北美控制权的更大冲突的一部分。弗朗索瓦-皮埃尔·里戈·德·沃德勒伊总督率领约1,600名法军正规军、加拿大民兵和原住民盟友，穿越冰封地带，袭击位于乔治湖南端、纽约省境内的英国堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Tarvis was fought during 21–23 March 1797 near present-day Tarvisio in far northeast Italy, about 12 kilometres (7 mi) west-by-southwest of the three-border conjunction with Austria and Slovenia, and was the final battle before the end of the War of the First Coalition. In the battle, three divisions of a First French Republic army commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte attacked several columns of the retreating Habsburg Austrian army led by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen.

zh.s: 塔尔维斯战役于1797年3月21日至23日在意大利东北部、今塔尔维西奥附近爆发，地点距奥地利、斯洛文尼亚和意大利三国交界处以西偏南约12公里（7英里）。这是第一次反法同盟战争结束前的最后一场战役。拿破仑·波拿巴指挥法兰西第一共和国军队的3个师，进攻由特申公爵查理大公率领、正在撤退的哈布斯堡奥地利军队。

en.s: The Battle of Feldkirch (23 March 1799) saw a Republican French corps led by André Masséna attack a weaker Habsburg Austrian force under Franz Jellacic. Defending fortified positions, the Austrians repulsed all of the French columns, though the struggle lasted until nightfall. This and other French setbacks in southern Germany soon caused Masséna to go on the defensive. The War of the Second Coalition combat occurred at the Austrian town of Feldkirch, Vorarlberg, located 158 kilometres (98 mi) west of Innsbruck. On a flimsy pretext, a Republican French army invaded Switzerland in January 1798 and forced the country into an uneasy alliance marked by occasional revolts.

zh.s: 1799年3月23日，安德烈·马塞纳率领法兰西共和国军一个军，进攻弗朗茨·耶拉契奇指挥、人数较少的哈布斯堡奥军。奥军依托坚固阵地，击退所有法军纵队，战斗一直持续至天黑。这次失败及法军在德国南部的其他挫折，很快迫使马塞纳转入防御。战斗属于第二次反法同盟战争，地点为奥地利福拉尔贝格的费尔德基希，距因斯布鲁克以西158公里（98英里）。此前，法军以薄弱借口于1798年1月入侵瑞士，迫使该国加入一个不稳定的联盟，其间不时爆发反抗。

en.t: Alexander became Emperor of Russia when his father was assassinated on 23 March 1801
en.s: Alexander I of Russia (Russian: Александр I Павлович, romanized: Aleksandr I Pavlovich, IPA: [ɐlʲɪkˈsandr ˈpavləvʲɪtɕ]; 23 December [O.S. 12 December] 1777 – 1 December [O.S. 19 November] 1825), nicknamed "the Blessed", was Emperor of Russia from 1801, the first King of Congress Poland from 1815, and the Grand Duke of Finland from 1809 to his death in 1825. He ruled Russia during the period of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.t: 亚历山大一世继位为俄国皇帝
zh.s: 1801年3月23日，保罗一世遇刺后，其子亚历山大一世继位为俄罗斯皇帝，在位至1825年。他还从1809年起担任芬兰大公、1815年起成为首任波兰会议王国国王，统治俄罗斯的时期跨越拿破仑战争。

en.s: The capture of HMS Penguin was a single-ship action which took place on March 23, 1815 as part of the War of 1812. It occurred when United States Navy brig USS Hornet under the command of James Biddle encountered the British Royal Navy brig-sloop HMS Penguin off Tristan da Cunha, and was one of several naval engagements which occurred after the conflict ended due to the signing of the Treaty of Ghent in 1815.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间，美国海军双桅横帆船“黄蜂”号于1815年3月23日在特里斯坦-达库尼亚附近遇到英国皇家海军单桅帆船“企鹅”号，并将其俘获。这是一场单舰交战，也是1815年《根特条约》签署、战争结束后发生的数场海战之一。

en.s: The Konbaung dynasty (Burmese: ကုန်းဘောင်မင်းဆက်), also known as the Third Burmese Empire (တတိယမြန်မာနိုင်ငံတော်), was the last dynasty that ruled Burma from 1752 to 1885. It created the second-largest empire in Burmese history and continued the administrative reforms begun by the Toungoo dynasty, laying the foundations of the modern state of Burma.

zh.t: 一场强烈地震摧毁贡榜王朝旧都因瓦（今缅甸境内）
zh.s: 贡榜王朝（缅甸语：ကုန်းဘောင်မင်းဆက်），也称缅甸第三帝国（တတိယမြန်မာနိုင်ငံတော်），是1752年至1885年统治缅甸的最后一个王朝。它建立了缅甸历史上第二大的帝国，延续了东吁王朝开启的行政改革，并为现代缅甸国家奠定基础。

en.s: The First Italian War of Independence (Italian: Prima guerra d'indipendenza italiana), part of the Risorgimento or unification of Italy, was fought by the Kingdom of Sardinia (Piedmont) and Italian volunteers against the Austrian Empire and other conservative states from 23 March 1848 to 22 August 1849 in the Italian Peninsula. The conflict was preceded by the outbreak of the Sicilian revolution of 1848 against the House of Bourbon-Two Sicilies.

zh.s: 第一次意大利独立战争于1848年3月23日至1849年8月22日在意大利半岛进行，由撒丁王国（皮埃蒙特）和意大利志愿军，对抗奥地利帝国及其他保守国家，属于意大利复兴与统一运动的一部分。此前，西西里已于1848年爆发反对波旁-两西西里王室的革命。

en.s: The Battle of Novara (or Battle of Bicocca; Bicocca being a borough of Novara) was one of the battles fought between the Austrian Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia during the First Italian War of Independence, within the era of Italian unification. Lasting the whole day of 22 March 1849 and ending at dawn on 23 March, it resulted in a severe defeat and retreat of the Piedmontese (Sardinian) army.

en.s: The First Battle of Kernstown was fought on March 23, 1862, in Frederick County and Winchester, Virginia, the opening battle of Confederate Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's campaign through the Shenandoah Valley during the American Civil War. Attempting to tie down the Union forces in the Valley, under the overall command of Maj. Gen. Nathaniel P. Banks, Jackson received incorrect intelligence that a small detachment under Col. Nathan Kimball was vulnerable, but it was in fact a full infantry division more than twice the size of Jackson's force. His initial cavalry attack was forced back and he immediately reinforced it with a small infantry brigade.

zh.s: 第一次克恩斯敦战役于1862年3月23日在弗吉尼亚州弗雷德里克县与温彻斯特发生，是美国内战中南军托马斯·J.‘石墙’杰克逊少将谢南多厄河谷战役的揭幕战。杰克逊希望牵制纳撒尼尔·P.班克斯少将统辖的河谷北军，却收到错误情报，以为内森·金博尔上校只有一支易受攻击的小分队，实际对方是一个完整步兵师，人数超过杰克逊所部的两倍。他最初的骑兵进攻被击退后，立即投入一个小型步兵旅增援。

en.s: The siege of Fort Macon took place from March 23 to April 26, 1862, on the Outer Banks of Carteret County, North Carolina. It was part of Union Army General Ambrose E. Burnside's North Carolina Expedition during the American Civil War. In late March, 1862, Major General Burnside’s army advanced on Fort Macon, a casemated masonry fort that commanded the channel to Beaufort, 35 miles (56 km) southeast of New Bern.

en.t: The University of California is founded in Oakland, California when the Organic Act is signed into law
en.s: The University of California (UC) is California's system of public research universities. Headquartered in Oakland, the system is composed of ten campuses at Berkeley, Davis, Irvine, Los Angeles, Merced, Riverside, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Barbara, and Santa Cruz. The system is the state's land-grant university. Under the California Master Plan for Higher Education, the University of California is a part of the state's three-system public postsecondary education plan, which also includes the California Community Colleges and California State University systems.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚大学于1868年3月23日成立，现为加州的公立研究型大学系统，总部在奥克兰，在伯克利、戴维斯、欧文、洛杉矶、默塞德、河滨、圣迭戈、旧金山、圣巴巴拉和圣克鲁兹设有十所分校。它也是该州的赠地大学，与加州社区学院和加州州立大学系统共同构成州高等教育总体规划下的三大公立体系。

en.s: The Battle of Topáter was fought on March 23, 1879 between Chile and Bolivia, and was the first battle of the War of the Pacific. The Chileans were taking possession of the Antofagasta (Litoral) province, at that time a part of Bolivia. The Bolivian troops, quite few in number, decided to make a stand in the town of Calama. On their way to occupy Calama, 554 Chilean troops, including cavalry and with two Krupp rifled guns, were opposed by 135 Bolivian soldiers and civilian residents led by Dr. Ladislao Cabrera, a civilian and a political authority in the region.

en.s: The English Football League (EFL) is a league of professional clubs from England and Wales. en.t: Mirza Ghulam Ahmad establishes the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community in Ludhiana
en.s: On March 23, 1889, Mirza Ghulam Ahmad formally accepted pledges of allegiance from his followers at a home in Ludhiana, in British India. The ceremony marked the establishment of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community, a religious movement within Islam.
en.n: The founding ceremony took place in Ludhiana; Qadian was Ahmad’s home town.

zh.s: 1889年3月23日，米尔扎·古拉姆·艾哈迈德在英属印度卢迪亚纳的一处住宅中，正式接受追随者宣誓效忠。这场仪式标志着伊斯兰教内部的艾哈迈底亚穆斯林社团成立。

en.s: The Theriso revolt (Greek: Επανάσταση του Θερίσου, romanized: Epanástasi tou Therísou) was an insurrection that broke out in March 1905 against the government of Crete, then an autonomous state under Ottoman suzerainty. The revolt was led by the Cretan politician Eleftherios Venizelos, and is named after his mother's native village, Theriso, the focal point of the revolt.
en.n: Eleftherios Venizelos calls for Crete's union with Greece, and begins what is to be known as the Theriso revolt.

zh.s: 特里西起义（希腊语：Επανάσταση του Θερίσου；罗马化：Epanástasi tou Therísou）是1905年3月爆发的一场反抗克里特政府的起义。当时克里特是奥斯曼帝国宗主权下的自治政体。起义由克里特政治家埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯领导，因他母亲的故乡特里西村而得名；该村也是起义的中心。
zh.n: 埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯呼吁克里特与希腊合并，由此揭开后来称为特里西起义的序幕。

en.s: On March 23, 1913—Easter Sunday—a devastating tornado outbreak affected the northern Great Plains and sections of the Upper Midwest, lasting approximately 31⁄2 hours. It was the most violent tornado outbreak to affect the northern Great Plains on so early a date in the year—a record that still stands as of 2020. That day, four F4 tornadoes affected portions of eastern Nebraska and western Iowa, killing at least 168 people.

zh.s: 1913年3月23日复活节星期日，美国北部大平原和中西部上部部分地区遭遇严重龙卷风，持续约3个半小时。这是北部大平原有记录以来该年年初最猛烈的一次龙卷风灾害，截至2020年仍未有纪录打破。当日有4场F4级龙卷风袭击内布拉斯加州东部和爱荷华州西部，至少造成168人死亡。

en.t: In Milan, Italy, Benito Mussolini founds his Fascist political movement
en.s: Benito Amilcare Andrea Mussolini (29 July 1883 – 28 April 1945) was an Italian politician, journalist, and dictator who led the Kingdom of Italy as a fascist dictatorship from 1922 until his overthrow in 1943. Known under his rule as Il Duce, he founded fascism in 1919 with the creation of the Fasci Italiani di Combattimento, which became the National Fascist Party (PNF) in 1921.

zh.t: 墨索里尼创建意大利战斗法西斯

en.s: The Scramoge ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 23 March 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. The IRA ambushed a lorry carrying British troops and Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) officers at Scramoge, near Strokestown in County Roscommon. Three British soldiers and an RIC officer were killed, while two RIC 'Black and Tans' were captured and shot dead shortly after.

en.s: The 1931 Santa Catalina mutiny took place on March 23, 1931, at the Santa Catalina Fort, located in the neighbourhood of Barrios Altos of Lima, Peru. en.s: The Indian independence movement was a series of political efforts from the mid-1880s to 1947 that took place in the Indian subcontinent with the aim of ending British colonial rule. The first nationalistic movement took root when the Indian National Congress (INC) was formed in 1885. Prominent moderate leaders of the INC worked on demands such as greater economic rights for Indians and the right to appear for Indian Civil Service examinations in British India.
en.n: Bhagat Singh, Shivaram Rajguru and Sukhdev Thapar are hanged for the killing of a deputy superintendent of police during the Indian independence movement.

zh.s: 1971年3月23日，哥伦比亚特区举行特别选举，选出代表全区国会选区、在联邦众议院没有表决权的代表。这是该席位重新设立后的首次选举，此前诺顿·P.奇普曼曾在重建时期短暂担任这一职位。民主党人沃尔特·E.福恩特罗伊获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 23 March 1980. The results, like with the other elections in communist Poland, were controlled by the communist government. The results of the 1980 election exactly duplicated the 1976 elections, which were only marginally different from those of the preceding years.

en.s: The 1982 Guatemalan coup d'état was a successful military overthrow in Guatemala by junior military officers, ousting the Romeo Lucas Garcia administration and installing a three-man military junta headed by General Efraín Ríos Montt. The general ruled for a brief but bloody 17 months before being overthrown by his defense minister General Oscar Mejia Victores in another coup.

zh.s: 1982年危地马拉政变是一场由军中少壮派军官发动的成功军事政变。军官推翻了罗梅奥·卢卡斯·加西亚政府，成立由埃弗拉因·里奥斯·蒙特将军领导的三人军政府。里奥斯·蒙特执政17个月，期间局势短暂但十分血腥，后来又被国防部长奥斯卡·梅希亚·比克托雷斯将军发动的另一次政变推翻。

en.s: The 1986 Full Members' Cup final was a football match which took place at Wembley Stadium on 23 March 1986. It was the final of the inaugural Full Members' Cup, the competition created in the wake of the 1985 ban on English clubs from European competitions following the Heysel disaster. Contested between First Division sides Chelsea and Manchester City, the game produced nine goals, with Chelsea prevailing 5–4.

zh.s: 1986年全体会员杯决赛于1986年3月23日在温布利球场举行，是该赛事的首届决赛。英格兰俱乐部因海瑟尔惨案而被禁止参加欧洲赛事后，英格兰足球界创办了这项赛事。决赛由英格兰甲级联赛球队切尔西对阵曼城，双方共打入9球，切尔西以5比4获胜。

en.s: The elections to the Eighth Kerala Assembly were held on 23 March 1987. The UDF and the LDF were the two major political fronts in the arena. The UDF had the INC(I), IUML, KC(J), KC(M), NDP (P), SRP(S) and the RSP(S) as its constituents. The LDF consisted of the CPI(M), CPI, RSP, IC(S), Janata Party and the Lok Dal.

zh.s: 印度喀拉拉邦于1987年3月23日举行第八届邦议会选举，主要由联合民主阵线与左翼民主阵线竞争。联合民主阵线包括印度国民大会党（英迪拉派）、印度联盟穆斯林联盟、喀拉拉国大党（约瑟夫派）、喀拉拉国大党（马尼派）、民族民主党（P派）、社会主义共和党（S派）及革命社会党（S派）。左翼民主阵线由印度共产党（马克思主义）、印度共产党、革命社会党、印度国大党（社会主义派）、人民党及人民党（Lok Dal）组成。

en.t: 1987 Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly election
en.s: Election for the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir were held on 23 March 1987. Farooq Abdullah was reappointed as the Chief Minister. The election is widely perceived to have been rigged. After the following elections to the Parliament in 1989, which saw low turn-out, Governor's Rule was declared in Jammu and Kashmir in 1990, which lasted till 1996.

zh.t: 1987年查谟和克什米尔邦议会选举
zh.s: 印度查谟和克什米尔邦于1987年3月23日举行选举。法鲁克·阿卜杜拉再次出任首席部长。这次选举普遍被认为遭到操纵。1989年议会选举投票率偏低后，查谟和克什米尔于1990年实施总统管治，一直持续到1996年。

en.t: Angolan and Cuban forces defeat South Africa in the Battle of Cuito Cuanavale
en.s: The Battle of Cuito Cuanavale was fought intermittently between 14 August 1987 and 23 March 1988, south and east of Cuito Cuanavale, Angola, by the People's Armed Forces for the Liberation of Angola (FAPLA) and Cuba against South Africa and the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA) during the Angolan Civil War and South African Border War.

zh.t: 库托夸纳瓦莱战役结束
zh.s: 库托夸纳瓦莱战役于1987年8月14日至1988年3月23日在安哥拉库托夸纳瓦莱以南和以东断续进行。安哥拉内战和南非边境战争期间，安哥拉人民解放军与古巴军队对阵南非军队及安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟。

en.s: General elections were held in Zimbabwe on 23 March 1990 to elect the President and Parliament. They were the first elections to be contested under the amended constitution of 1987, which established an elected executive presidency and abolished the Senate. They were also the first ever elections in the country to be contested on a single roll, i.e. with no separate voting for whites and blacks. The result was a victory for incument President Robert Mugabe, whose ZANU-PF party won 117 of the 120 elected seats in Parliament.

zh.s: 津巴布韦于1990年3月23日举行总统和议会选举。这是依据1987年修订宪法举行的首次选举；该宪法设立民选、拥有行政权的总统，并废除参议院。这也是该国首次使用统一选民名册投票，不再将白人与黑人分开投票。现任总统罗伯特·穆加贝获胜，其领导的津巴布韦非洲民族联盟—爱国阵线赢得议会120个民选席位中的117席。

en.s: The Sierra Leone Civil War (1991–2002) began on 23 March 1991 when the Revolutionary United Front (RUF), with support from the special forces of Charles Taylor’s National Patriotic Front of Liberia (NPFL), intervened in Sierra Leone in an attempt to overthrow the Joseph Momoh government. The resulting civil war lasted 11 years, enveloped the country, and left over 50,000 dead. During the first year of the war, the RUF took control of large swathes of territory in eastern and southern Sierra Leone, which were rich in alluvial diamonds.

zh.s: 塞拉利昂内战始于1991年3月23日。革命联合阵线在查尔斯·泰勒领导的利比里亚全国爱国阵线特种部队支持下，进入塞拉利昂，试图推翻约瑟夫·莫莫政府。内战持续11年，席卷全国，造成超过50,000人死亡，至2002年结束。战争第一年，革命联合阵线夺取了塞拉利昂东部与南部大片盛产冲积钻石的地区。

en.t: 1993 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: A spill of the leadership of the Liberal Party of Australia took place on 23 March 1993, following the 1993 federal election. The spill was won by incumbent leader John Hewson over former leader John Howard by 47 votes to 30 while backbencher Bruce Reid attracted only one sole vote, presumably his own. For the Deputy leadership Michael Wooldridge won against Peter Costello.

zh.t: 1993年澳大利亚自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 澳大利亚自由党于1993年3月23日举行党魁选举，起因是1993年联邦选举。时任党魁约翰·休森以47票对30票击败前党魁约翰·霍华德，保住党魁职位；后座议员布鲁斯·里德只获得1票，推测是他投给自己的。副党魁选举中，迈克尔·伍尔德里奇击败彼得·科斯特洛。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 593 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Sheremetyevo International Airport, Moscow, Russia, to Kai Tak Airport in Hong Kong. On 23 March 1994, the aircraft operating the route, an Airbus A310 flown by Aeroflot, crashed into the Kuznetsk Alatau mountain range in Kemerovo Oblast, killing all 63 passengers and 12 crew members on board.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空593号航班空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空593号航班是从俄罗斯莫斯科谢列梅捷沃国际机场飞往香港启德机场的定期国际客运航班。1994年3月23日，执飞的空客A310客机在克麦罗沃州库兹涅茨克阿拉套山脉坠毁，机上63名乘客和12名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Green Ramp disaster was a 1994 mid-air collision and subsequent ground collision at Pope Air Force Base in North Carolina. It killed twenty-four members of the U.S. Army's 82nd Airborne Division preparing for an airborne training operation. As of 2026, this incident has the largest number of ground fatalities for an accidental crash of an aircraft on U.S. soil.

zh.s: 1994年，北卡罗来纳州波普空军基地上空发生空中相撞，随后又发生地面碰撞，造成绿坡空降事故。事故造成美国陆军第82空降师24名士兵死亡，当时他们正准备进行空降训练。截至2026年，这是美国境内飞机意外坠毁事故中地面死亡人数最多的一起。

en.t: At an election rally in Tijuana, Mexican presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio is assassinated by Mario Aburto Martínez
en.s: Luis Donaldo Colosio Murrieta (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈlwis doˈnal.do koˈlo.sjo muˈrje.ta]; 10 February 1950 – 23 March 1994) was a Mexican politician, economist, and Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) presidential candidate, who was assassinated at a campaign rally in Tijuana during the presidential campaign of 1994.

zh.t: 墨西哥总统候选人科洛西奥在蒂华纳遇刺
zh.s: 路易斯·多纳尔多·科洛西奥·穆列塔（西班牙语发音：[ˈlwis doˈnal.do koˈlo.sjo muˈrje.ta]；1950年2月10日—1994年3月23日）是墨西哥政治家、经济学家，也是革命制度党总统候选人。1994年总统竞选期间，他在蒂华纳的一场竞选集会上遇刺身亡。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Taiwan on 23 March 1996. It was Taiwan's first direct presidential election, officially the Republic of China. In the previous eight elections, the president and vice president had been chosen in a ballot of the deputies of the National Assembly, in accordance with the 1947 constitution. These were the first free and direct elections in the history of Taiwan. Lee Teng-hui was re-elected President, and Lien Chan as Vice President. Lee stood as the candidate for the ruling Kuomintang. He won a majority of 54% of the votes cast.

zh.s: 台湾于1996年3月23日举行首次直接选举中华民国总统的投票。此前八次选举都依照1947年宪法，由国民大会代表投票选出总统与副总统。这也是台湾历史上首次自由、直接的总统选举。执政党国民党的候选人李登辉以54%的过半得票率连任，连战当选副总统。

en.s: The Battle off the coast of Mullaitivu was a naval battle fought between the Sri Lanka Navy and Sea Tigers on 23 March 1997, off the coast of town of Mullaitivu which has been under control of the LTTE since the Battle of Mullaitivu in 1996.

en.s: WrestleMania 13 was a 1997 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and presented by PlayStation. It was the 13th annual WrestleMania and was held on March 23, 1997, at the Rosemont Horizon in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. This was the second WrestleMania held at this venue after the middle portion of WrestleMania 2 in 1986.

zh.s: 第13届摔角狂热大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现WWE）制作、由PlayStation呈现的1997年按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月23日在伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特的罗斯蒙特地平线体育馆举行。这是继1986年第2届摔角狂热的中间一部分比赛之后，该场馆第二次举办摔角狂热。

en.t: Gunmen assassinate Paraguay's Vice President Luis María Argaña
en.s: Luis María del Corazón de Jesús Dionisio Argaña Ferraro (October 3, 1932 – March 23, 1999) was a Paraguayan politician and jurist. A prominent and influential member of the Colorado Party, he was a Supreme Court judge, unsuccessfully ran for the Colorado Party's nomination for president in the 1993 election and eventually was elected Vice-President in the 1998 election, but was assassinated seven months after assuming office in March 1999 at a time when it appeared likely that he would inherit the presidency from Raúl Cubas, who was on the verge of being impeached.

zh.t: 巴拉圭副总统阿尔加尼亚遭枪手暗杀
zh.s: 路易斯·玛丽亚·德尔·科拉松·德·赫苏斯·迪奥尼西奥·阿尔加尼亚·费拉罗（1932年10月3日—1999年3月23日）是巴拉圭政治家和法学家，也是红党中颇具影响力的成员。他曾任最高法院法官，1993年竞选红党总统候选人提名未果，后于1998年当选副总统。1999年3月，在劳尔·库巴斯总统濒临弹劾、外界普遍认为阿尔加尼亚将接任总统之际，他上任七个月后遭到暗杀。

en.t: 2007 Iranian arrest of Royal Navy personnel
en.s: On 23 March 2007, fifteen Royal Navy personnel from HMS Cornwall were searching a merchant vessel when they were surrounded by the Navy of the Iranian Revolutionary Guards and detained off the Iran–Iraq coast. zh.t: 2007年伊朗扣押英国皇家海军人员事件
zh.s: 2007年3月23日，英国皇家海军“康沃尔”号的15名人员在搜查一艘商船时，被伊朗革命卫队海军包围并扣押，地点在伊朗与伊拉克海岸附近。英国方面称这艘商船当时位于伊拉克水域，伊朗方面则坚持称其位于伊朗领海。

en.t: Official opening of Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in Hyderabad, India
en.s: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (IATA: HYD, ICAO: VOHS) is an international airport that serves Hyderabad, the capital of the Indian state of Telangana. It is located in Shamshabad, about 24 kilometres (15 mi) south of Hyderabad and it was opened on 23 March 2008 to replace Begumpet Airport, which was till then the sole civilian airport serving Hyderabad.

zh.t: 拉吉夫·甘地国际机场正式启用
zh.s: 拉吉夫·甘地国际机场（IATA代码：HYD；ICAO代码：VOHS）为印度特伦甘纳邦首府海得拉巴提供航空服务，位于海得拉巴以南约24公里（15英里）的沙姆沙巴德。机场于2008年3月23日启用，取代了此前海得拉巴唯一的民用机场贝甘佩特机场。

en.s: The Battle of Alasay, codenamed Operation Dinner Out, was a military operation carried out by French troops of the Chasseurs Alpins's 27e Battalion and the Afghan National Army (ANA) 1st Kandak (battalion) between 14 and 23 March 2009. Marine Embedded Training Team 6-4 as well as other US units provided air support, both with attack helicopters and A-10 and F-15E strike aircraft. The operation enabled the construction of two bases for the Afghan Army in the Alasay valley, which had been guerrilla control since 2006.

zh.s: 阿拉赛战役代号‘外出用餐行动’，由法国阿尔卑斯猎兵第27营与阿富汗国民军第1营于2009年3月14日至23日实施。美国海军陆战队第6-4嵌入式训练小组及其他美军单位，使用攻击直升机、A-10与F-15E攻击机提供空中支援。行动使阿富汗军队得以在自2006年以来由游击队控制的阿拉赛谷地修建两座基地。

en.s: FedEx Express Flight 80 was a scheduled cargo flight from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport in the People's Republic of China, to Narita International Airport in Narita, Chiba Prefecture (near Tokyo), Japan. zh.s: 联邦快递80号航班是从中国广州白云国际机场飞往日本东京附近、千叶县成田国际机场的定期货运航班。2009年3月23日日本标准时间6时48分（协调世界时3月22日21时48分），执飞的麦道MD-11F货机、注册号N526FE，在强阵风条件下尝试降落34L跑道时坠毁。

en.t: The Affordable Care Act becomes law in the United States
en.s: The Affordable Care Act (ACA), formally the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (PPACA) and informally known as Obamacare, is a landmark U.S. federal statute enacted by the 111th United States Congress and signed into law by President Barack Obama on March 23, 2010. Together with amendments made to it by the Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act of 2010, it represents the U.S. healthcare system's most significant regulatory overhaul and expansion of coverage since the enactment of Medicare and Medicaid in 1965.

en.t: 2026 Colombian Air Force Lockheed C-130 crash
en.s: On 23 March 2026, a Colombian Aerospace Force Lockheed C-130 Hercules crashed into dense jungle while taking off from Caucayá Airport in Puerto Leguízamo en route to Tres de Mayo Airport in Puerto Asís, both located in Colombia's Putumayo department near the border with Peru and Ecuador. There were 126 people on board, of whom 69 were killed, and 57 survived with injuries.

zh.t: 2026年哥伦比亚空军C-130运输机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2026年3月23日，哥伦比亚航空航天部队一架洛克希德C-130“大力神”运输机从考卡亚机场起飞，飞往普图马约省波多黎各阿西斯的特雷斯德马约机场途中，在茂密丛林中坠毁。两座机场都位于靠近秘鲁和厄瓜多尔边境的普图马约省。机上126人中，69人死亡，57人受伤后生还。
